gloss: to the end; persistently; strictly; only

definitions.explanation: Without giving up; continuing firmly until a goal is achieved.
Used to emphasize limitation - that something is limited to a particular scope or purpose.

examples.japanese: あくまで⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
examples.english: To fight to the bitter end.

examples.japanese: あくまで⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}した→通す：02300_toosu⟧。
examples.english: They persistently stuck to their own opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あくまで⟦{無実|むじつ}→無実：09504_mujitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{続|つづ}けた→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: He persistently continued to claim his innocence.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あくまで⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦です→だ：09496_da⟧。
あくまで⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見解|けんかい}→見解：02743_kenkai⟧⟦です→だ：09496_da⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧...
examples.english: This is strictly my personal opinion, but...

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あくまで⟦{目安|めやす}→目安：00276_meyasu⟧⟦なので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: These figures are merely a guideline and may differ from actual values.

notes:
KANJI:
Can be written as {飽|あ}くまで, though hiragana is more common.

USAGE PATTERNS:

Sense 1 (persistent):
・あくまで⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to resist to the end)
・あくまで⟦{否定|ひてい}→否定：03707_hitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to persistently deny)
・あくまで⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧ (to fight to the bitter end)

Sense 2 (limitation/qualifier):
・あくまで⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧ (strictly for reference)
・あくまで⟦{私見|しけん}→私見：noentry⟧⟦です→だ：09496_da⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ (this is just my opinion, but...)
・あくまで⟦{目安|めやす}→目安：00276_meyasu⟧ (just a guideline)
・あくまで⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧ (just a tentative plan)

NUANCE:
In sense 2, often used to disclaim responsibility or soften a statement. Very common in business Japanese to hedge assertions.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・⟦どこまでも→どこまでも：noentry⟧ - to the end, everywhere
・⟦{断|だん}じて→断じて：noentry⟧ - firmly, absolutely
